item.title: Dishonorable Work
item.description: Every time I look at you "working," you're sitting in the corner, shoulders slouched, and head down on your phone. It's truly a sad site to see every time I see you "working." But that's your "break," which you have about 20 a day. When you are "working," you're still watching some videos on the phone, or hunched over the table looking at your phone. item.title: If we ever get out of here
item.description: They don’t have the political capital or goodwill to sustain this. Pretty soon there is going to be a run on the metaphorical bank of the corrupt system propped up so badly right now. So when that happens don’t panic and be thankful you held to your principles on everything, regardless of the state of the soda tax. Maybe you’ll be free. I hope you can do that. item.title: Comeback Kitchen, Portland Edition
item.description: Coming back from life-threatening injuries is never part of anyone’s plans, but for two Portland chefs, that became their reality. A few years after both Darell Preston of LoRell’s Chicken Shack and Jeff Chow of Mama Chow’s Kitchen suffered major trauma, they not only lived to tell the tale, but are thriving. LoRell’s is back and doing more business than ever at the Lloyd Center Mall—a location not exactly known for its bustling commerce. Chow...

item.title: What a delight to see you
item.description: It's so nice to see you. Happy even with all that this world is. I would love to just sit and talk with you and laugh and embrace all this world could give. Thankful that we can still be friends.
